# E0343: a lens moves an optional field to a required one with no fallback

A field optional in the source and required in the target cannot simply be
copied: an instance that lacks it would have nothing to put there. coalesce says
what to use when it is absent.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a:  string
	b?: int
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
	c: bool
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		c: true
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	a: string
	b: int
	c: bool
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0343]: b is optional in 0.0 and required in 1.0: write b: _coalesce(v0_0.b, <fallback>) to say what to use when it is absent
 --> history/1.0.thema:3:2
  |
3 |     b: int
  |     ^
  |
```
